name: observational-memory
description: Compaction as observational memory: in the background, after each turn and during a long one, an Observer (GPT-5.6 Luna through pi) turns each ~10k-token chunk of the conversation into timestamped, prioritized observations (up to four chunks at once), quoting the user's decisions and constraints verbatim, a Reflector condenses the other observations when they grow, and compaction itself cuts at the observed watermark with no model call, keeping recent messages whole, with every user message quoted verbatim and the latest as the next step unless it is the first, framed as the built-in summary is. Skills in use are carried across compactions, and an om_recall tool searches the full transcript, reading the transcript file after a resume.
